outcome.reason: The incident was caused by a credential secret desynchronization between the database and the billing application. The database password was rotated to authoritative generation b9b26c30a42a65968efab3834749fdbf83374b60e371d95d1dc3ee3e8fd2a5ee (held in db-credentials), while the billing-api Deployment and running pod were consuming the stale credential generation 0aab604799348439ce4cc92447e78eebc30206aee3d5625982cddfd410238f40 from billing-credentials (resource version 113923). Network connectivity to PostgreSQL was healthy, but authentication was rejected by the database. The issue was resolved by synchronizing billing-credentials to the authoritative credential generation (digest b9b26c30a42a65968efab3834749fdbf83374b60e371d95d1dc3ee3e8fd2a5ee) and executing a controlled rollout of the billing-api Deployment.
